title: Endothelial Dysfunction in Acute Exacerbations of Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD)
brief_summary: The purpose of the study is to determine a possible association between the clinical entity of exacerbation, markers of systemic inflammation and endothelial dysfunction in patients with COPD.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* presence of COPD according to standard criteria
* acute exacerbation of COPD according to recommended international criteria
* over 40 years of age
* history of at least 10 py

Exclusion Criteria:

* pneumonia
* history or signs of congestive heart failure,
* acute myocardial infarction
* thoracotomy incl. resection of lungtissue
* interstitial lung disease
* acute or chronic renal failure
* active malignancy
* autoimmune disease
study_population: Patients with COPD diagnosed according to standard criteria in the state of acute exacerbation
